personality_one_liner: A calm, premium, and trustworthy editorial space that lets fashion content breathe.

spacing.rule: Editorial spacing: generous vertical rhythm, let typography breathe. Avoid dense grouping.

dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. This app relies on flat, solid surfaces with borders and generous whitespace.

screens.name: Home / Schedule
screens.purpose: A quick overview of today's timeline and an entry point for NLP scheduling.

states.empty: Subtle abstract texture with 'No appointments today' text and a button to schedule.
states.error: Text stating 'Could not load schedule' with a 'Try Again' button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Today's Agenda' in serif. A prominent text input box at the top or bottom for the Smart NLP Scheduling ('Schedule a design call...'). Below that, a clean timeline view of today's events, using the color-coded categories as left-borders or small indicator dots.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: A full month or week view with toggleable category filters.
screens.layout: Top row of pills/toggles for the 4 modes: Design Call (Clay/Terracotta), Measurement Call (Ochre), Sending Pieces (Sage), Personal (Grey). The calendar grid below is spacious, with serif numbers. Events are indicated by minimal colored dots or thin lines matching the toggles.

screens.name: Clients List
screens.purpose: A directory of the freelancer's clients.

states.empty: Illustration/Texture with 'No clients yet. Add your first client.'

screens.layout: Editorial list layout. Large, high-quality circular or square avatars (real fashion photos), with the client's name in serif and last interaction date in sans-serif. 'Create Client' FAB or sticky bottom button.

screens.name: Client Detail
screens.purpose: A comprehensive profile for a single client including contact, measurements, PDFs, and invoices.

states.empty: N/A - Profile will show empty states within its sections (e.g., 'No invoices').

screens.layout: Hero section with a cover image (fashion editorial photo) and gradient scrim. Client name and basic info overlaid. Below: A segmented control or simple scrolling page with sections: 1. Measurements (clean key-value pairs). 2. Moodboards/PDFs (horizontal scrolling cards or grid). 3. Invoices (minimal table with clear 'Cleared/Pending' status text, no heavy borders). Include a 'Share Profile' action in the header.

client_avatar_placeholder.alt: Fashion editorial portrait of a model

client_cover_image.alt: Two stylish adults in bold outfits

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality. No glassmorphism, no heavy shadows. Use flat surfaces, hairlines (1pt borders), and generous whitespace.

For the 4 calendar modes, map them to our earthy palette to avoid banned colors (like bright purple). Use: Design Call -> Deep Clay/Terracotta (#A3523B), Measurement Call -> Ochre/Gold (#B38A58), Sending Pieces -> Sage (#5C6B5D), Personal -> Warm Grey (#8C8984).
Use Playfair Display for primary headers and client names. Use Satoshi for all body text, UI labels, and data (measurements, invoices).
For the Smart Scheduling NLP input, design a prominent, clean text area that feels like a premium journal entry rather than a standard chat input.
Implement the gradient scrim pattern (transparent to surfaceInverse) strictly when placing text over the client cover images.
Ensure the invoice table is extremely minimal. Avoid typical enterprise data grid styles. Use generous row padding and subtle bottom borders.
